scope:
Compose continuous G1 lid opening and hood removal in the established lab.

This is access preparation for the paper's Cary measurement workflow. It does
not execute reference/sample exchange, acquisition or the complete paper. The
lid is first opened 150 mm to clear the hood; that split is a reconstruction
inference, while complete hood removal is allowed by the manufacturer manual.
initial_conditions: Established complete laboratory; static tool and reference poses match optical_exchange_01 frame 0.
Cary DRA is installed and the reference is clamped at the port; installation and electrical connection are outside this access episode.
Main lid and removable hood start closed. Hood handle height and hose relief geometry are explicitly inferred operability revisions.
The instrument main lid remains partially open after this episode. Reference/sample exchange, measurement, closure and the complete paper workflow are not executed.
